The '''Reflex package''' boosted the regular impulses of the [[nervous system]], sharpening the efficiency of dexterous muscle action. Unfortunately, the lack of movement may have caused the user to suffer the odd lingering twitch.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 12 or higher.
